links.comparator_used: Original online orthopaedic oncology patient educational materials as written (baseline)
links.outcome: Readability of patient educational materials (FKGL, GFI, FRE), with accuracy (F1) and comprehension checked
links.effect: Baseline FKGL 8.7 ± 1.5, GFI 10.5 ± 1.9, FRE 53.9 ± 8.2. All five LLMs significantly improved readability (P < 0.001). ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek AI and Google Gemini produced the most readable outputs. Google Gemini had the highest F1 of 0.986 (range 0.765-0.986) and 100% comprehension.
links.tradeoff: Accuracy and comprehension were compromised for Meta AI when prompted below the sixth-grade level. F1 varied across LLMs, with a low of 0.765.
links.quote: All LLMs significantly improved readability (P < 0.001), and ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek AI, and Google Gemini conversion produced the most readable outputs.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompts for patient materials
